scope: Proposition 6.1 (Exclusion of an intermediate-bias crossing) of the manuscript “Hellinger contraction with arbitrary Boolean output bias” (preprints/Hellinger-contraction-with-arbitrary-Boolean-output-bias-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 119 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cc0bdb9cca4c6ab4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let f be a nonconstant Boolean function and suppose r2 2 ≤ m ≤ 37 50 , 21 25 ≤ s < 1. If b = h − 1 + s, then E(d) > r/s. Consequently a crossing as in Lemma 4.1 cannot occur in this range.
